summary: Tested the profile-screen Sign out with its confirm step (mouse and keyboard), the Delete profile confirm (regression), the device-location endpoint, the location field on admin accounts, the exact_location join on admin Live, and the admin static files (code review plus node --check). Backend: 11/11 pytest passed. Frontend: all checks passed. Nothing in the app needs fixing. Item 3 (Play should not flash back to Details) and the Android permission dialog are native Kotlin and were not tested.

minor.issue: exact_location is matched by username only, not by device_id. If an account has several boxes, every live session shows the location of the box that reported most recently, even when the session comes from a different box. Prefer the row whose device_id matches the session's device_id, and fall back to the latest row.

The handler upserts device_locations for any client_key without checking that the account exists. The ingest key ships inside the APK, so anyone who extracts it can write location rows for arbitrary usernames. The vesper_accounts update is a harmless no-op in that case. Low risk.
Every call triggers a Nominatim reverse-geocode with no cache or rate limit. Nominatim's policy is 1 request per second. Consider caching by rounded lat/lon.

ui_bugs.issue: After Cancel (or Esc), focus is not returned to the Sign out pill. document.activeElement becomes body, so a D-pad user has to press an arrow key before focus reappears. Minor.

verified: The profile-sign-out pill renders after Load from backup and is reachable with ArrowDown/ArrowRight.

Clicking the pill or pressing Enter opens the sign-out-confirm modal ('Sign out of this box?', no avatar), with focus on sign-out-cancel. Right/Left move between Cancel and Confirm, and Up keeps focus inside the modal.
Cancel click, Escape, backdrop click and Enter on Cancel all close the modal without signing out.
Enter on sign-out-confirm-btn logs out: login-screen appears, and it persists after a reload.

Regression: Manage profiles -> remove-p-test-1 opens delete-profile-confirm with the avatar, the 'Are you sure you want to delete "Test"?' title and 'Yes, delete', with focus on Cancel. Cancel closed it and the profile was kept.

device-location returns ok:true with the address '260, Elizabeth Street, Greek Precinct, Melbourne, Victoria, 3000, Australia'. No key or a wrong key gives 401; lat 123, lon -500 or a missing client_key gives 422.
admin/accounts shows testuser.location with lat, lon, address, map_url, accuracy_m and updated_at.
After a heartbeat, admin/active shows qa-sess-1 with exact_location set (device qa-dev). After /end the session is no longer listed.

Admin: node --check passes on app.js and on the inline script in index.html. Both renderTable and the Vesper 'Box location' cell escape the address and map_url (esc/escapeAttr) and fall back to the approximate place / 'Not shared yet'.
action_items: Optional: in admin_active, match exact_location by session device_id before falling back to username.
Optional: restore focus to the Sign out pill when the confirm modal closes without signing out.
critical_code_review_comments: presence.py admin_active: the username-only join, which can show the wrong box's location on multi-box accounts.
index.html renderTable (existing issue, not from this change): esc(s.content_title || '—') prints the literal text '—'.
vesper_accounts.location is overwritten by whichever box reported last. This is fine for one box per account but ambiguous for several.
